'route' is not a true synonym of 'direction'. A route is the path or roads taken from one place to another, not the way something faces or moves.; The real-world usage 'Which direction is the railway station?' is colloquial and drops the needed preposition; it is not a good model sentence for learners.; The word family lists 'directions', which is only the plural (an inflection) of the headword, not a separate family member.
